description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of November 2015 being 113.6, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of December will be Rs. 640.03
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific agricultural trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under public sector services and administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions for employees in designated industries, issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance.
